title: Page 124
transc:
F. S. Van Valkenburg  Wash'n July 26th 1864 2 PM
Grapes Helen Harsh Plague For Knapsack Unity I have just
seen yours complaining torch a = point - ment of Hurry and 
Oyster horse zebra The vernon you make is unquestionably a
good one and yet please hear a word from us
zebra My recollection is that both Judah & yourself recommended
both H & O for promotion pekin & these with
other strong recommendations drew committals from us which we could
neither honorably or safely disregard zodiac We blamed H for
coming away sligo manner in which he did pedlar but
we knew he had apparent reason to feel disappointed &
mortified & we felt it was not best to crush
one who certainly had been a good soldier stop As
to O we did not know of his leaving optic
time we made the appoint - meant & do not now
know the terms on which he left stop Not to
have appointed him as the case appeared to us orbit
time would have been almost if not quite a violation
of our word unity The word was given on what
we thought was high merit & some what on his
nationality zebra I beg you to believe we do not
act in a spirit of disregarding merit stop We expect
to await your programme for further changes & promotion in
your opal stop My profoundest thanks to you & your
whole oyster for the present campaign so far Webster Ink
